document.abstract: The third meeting of ISO/TC 36, the committee responsible for development of international standards for motion pictures, was held in June 1958. Attention was given to problems arising from both television and theatrical usage. Areas of mutual understanding and agreement were enlarged. Improvement in the ease of international exchange of theater and television program material is the predictable result of this work.
